name: orqeli
description: ORQELI Education — Academic records, examination marks, and report-card workflow foundation for schools in Zambia.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @orqeli/web" "npm run dev -w @orqeli/api"
scripts.dev:sandbox: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @orqeli/web" "npm run dev:sandbox -w @orqeli/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orqeli/api && npm run build -w @orqeli/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orqeli/api && npm run typecheck -w @orqeli/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @orqeli/api && npm run test -w @orqeli/web
